CVSS: Agent CLI, no network listener → AV:L (attacker relies on user running the agent / content). AC:L. AT:N. PR:N (no auth). UI:P (user runs task normally / passive). VC:H (all customer rows + notes disclosed — high-value canary). VI:N, VA:N. Subsequent systems: in-memory SQLite is inside agent process → no scope change; SC/SI/SA:N.

AIVSS: LC — attacker-controlled language via user task or retrieved content influences tool call: D or I. Path is "influenced through injection or the user" → indirect likely (I). But user task text reaching tool call directly = D (direct). I'll pick D? Entry point says "name argument ... influenced through injection or the user" — ambiguity. Choose D since user-supplied natural language directly reaches tool. Actually "injection" suggests retrieved content → I. Hmm. I'll say D with medium confidence, noting user-supplied text directly reaches tool invocation.

CP: no evidence of memory persistence in this path → N (single run; SQL result returned to model, no durable store). Could be N.

AP: Contained (agent process, same principal) → C? Effect confined to agent component reading DB in same process → C or N. The DB is inside agent process; effect on customer data within agent. C (relays across components same principal). I'll say C.

RH: no evaluator/reward channel on path; no verified episodes. reachable_proxy — is there a reward signal? No evaluator mentioned. reachable_proxy unknown → X. Facts: reachable_proxy null, isolation_verified null, verified_episodes null, episodes_reviewed null, locus null.

ES: fixed built-in tools, no argument constraints → tools are allowlisted but "material gaps in argument schemas" = M. Yes, M.

Applicability: agent pursues user task, selects actions (tool calls) → both true.

Automatable: model must emit payload name; can be induced but needs the model to comply → "No"? Payloads are scripted; the attack depends on model behavior. I'd say No (requires model cooperation... actually injection can be automated). The path requires "some input makes the model pass the crafted name" — depends on model. Say No.
